info.description: Append-only ledger entry for a student's matching-credit wallet. The source of truth for balance; student.creditBalance is a cached derivative.

amount.description: +3 on Grant, -1 on Reserve, 0 on Settle, +1 on Release.

ledgerKey.description: Idempotency key: grant:{dedupeKey} for the one-time grant, reserve:{matchRunId} / settle:{matchRunId} / release:{matchRunId} per run. A unique-constraint violation on insert means the operation already happened.
